ns2:section.sectionText: Course introduces students to community development practices and the participatory action research approach as related to social justice issues. Detailed information about the course is available at http://eslarp.illinois.edu/. Enrollment in this section is limited to freshmen and new transfer students in HDFS and requires online activities, attendance in two in-class sessions (September 4 and 11 from 3:30-4:50 p.m. in 132 Bevier Hall and one outreach experience.) STUDENTS SHOULD ALSO ENROLL IN HDFS 101, CRN 59642.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman or Transfer student - first time students.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Human & Community Development department.
